data.title: Bitcoin price today: August 7, 2026
data.description: The current price of Bitcoin (BTC) is approximately $64,940 as of Friday, August 7, 2026, up about 0.8% over the past 24 hours and roughly 2.8% over the past week. Bitcoin is holding gains made on Friday, when it climbed as high as about $65,300 after a much weaker-than-expected July jobs report ...
